The '''Wealth Level''' was a level in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. It held most houses on Utapau along with similar things. Pau City was on this level along with its main spaceport. The Wealth Level was one of the most populated levels in Pau City along with the [[Civic Level/Legends|Civic Level]].
